entries.2ae992c77b91c336: This business sells electricity generated by solar power. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥45 million. The facilities of consolidated subsidiary Soma Co., Ltd. and others are responsible for this.
entries.42f4b8ffe0ffc676: This business leases owned real estate. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥107 million. It leases part of Nagahori Osaka Building and other rental properties, including those in Setagaya Ward, Tokyo.
entries.4507d4368067230d: A company whose main business is manufacturing and selling jewelry, and which also leases real estate it owns and sells electricity generated by solar power.
entries.47e76ae14bd1b8f8: This division manufactures precious metal products such as necklace chains and rings at consolidated subsidiary Soma Co., Ltd. and at the company's production base, Atelier de Mobara. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.5e4080d0576f2cbf: This division wholesales jewelry to department stores and other jewelry wholesale customers through the company, Esujei Jewelry Co., Ltd., Nakaniwa Tokeiten Co., Ltd., Sho Co., Ltd. and Nagahori (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.b766c8dac89e4f2f: This division sells jewelry to consumers through directly operated stores, such as the flagship store 'Maison de NADIA', and through stores in shopping malls, fashion buildings and GMS operated by Nagahori Retail Co., Ltd. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.f05d6b85b8707c6d: This is the core business, manufacturing and selling jewelry. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,227 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue. Precious metal products are manufactured by consolidated subsidiary Soma Co., Ltd. and at the company's production site, Atelier de Mobara (Mobara City, Chiba Prefecture); together with products purchased from overseas and domestic suppliers, the company and its consolidated subsidiaries Esujei Jewelry Co., Ltd., Nakaniwa Tokeiten Co., Ltd. and Sho Co., Ltd. handle wholesale and retail, and consolidated subsidiary Nagahori Retail Co., Ltd. runs retail operations in shopping malls, fashion buildings and GMS. Nagahori (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. engages in jewelry wholesale in Hong Kong.
